items: A reputation management tool monitors reviews and mentions across review, social and ordering platforms so you can see how guests perceive your restaurant and act from one place.
Respond to every review, negative and positive alike: acknowledge and apologize for a poor experience, invite the guest back, and personalize your thanks for good reviews.
Offer private ways to give feedback, such as QR code surveys on tables or in delivery bags, so you can resolve issues one to one and grow your customer database.
Keep your Google listing complete, with accurate hours, photos and contact details, and use sentiment analytics on guest feedback to find what to improve in service and food.
